items: emit a typed CloudMicrophysicsPacket carrying phase-resolved condensate or water-path basis, cloud-fraction semantics, layer geometry, produced effective radius, source identity, and source-consumed radius when replaying source-native radiation
tag condensate/path semantics as in_cloud, grid_mean, or unknown; never erase this distinction
do not derive cloud color, opacity, local extinction or renderer density directly from RE_CLOUD/RE_ICE/RE_SNOW
do not multiply cloud fraction into local extinction by default; preserve subgrid/overlap provenance separately
own OpticalClosureIdentity and convert typed Weather state into a SpectralLayerOpticalPacket
evaluate liquid, ice and snow optical contributions separately before mixed-phase composition
preserve optical parameterization/LUT identity, effective-size definition, spectral bands, and non-delta versus delta-scaled quantities
record every radius clamp, fallback or category remap in OpticsInputLineage rather than hiding it
when reproducing locked HRRRv4 RRTMG, preserve the documented snow reuse of ice lookup tables as an explicit limitation
consume SpectralLayerOpticalPacket rather than raw microphysics effective-radius fields
reject physically routed packets that lack hydrometeor amount/path basis, optical-model identity, spectral identity or geometry/path basis
derive local sigma_t/sigma_s/sigma_a only through an explicit LocalVolumeOpticsAdapter with declared spatial assumptions
perform spectral-to-renderer RGB/color projection as a versioned evaluator transform and preserve the original spectral packet
keep artistic density, albedo, phase, multiple-scattering and performance controls evaluator-only; never write them back into Weather Canonical Truth
add OpticalClosureIdentity, OpticsInputLineage, SpectralLayerOpticalPacket, LocalVolumeOpticsAdapter, MixedPhaseCompositionRule and OpticsFallbackPolicy as candidate reusable contracts
require ProducedRadiusIdentity and ConsumedRadiusIdentity to remain distinguishable when an evaluator clamps, substitutes or reclassifies a state
treat path-integrated optical depth, local per-distance coefficients and display/RGB quantities as different typed quantities
split QA into semantic closure, numeric invariants and visual acceptance; a visually pleasing cloud is not semantic evidence

promotionAuthority: Xiaoma Judgment after a typed mixed-phase/partial-cloud spectral fixture closes through at least two independent renderer adapters and all applicable Weather runtime and replay gates remain satisfied
